_comment: Tuned oMLX recipe for Qwen 3.8 27B oQ4e on 32-64 GB Apple Silicon: native MTP (k=3) + ANE prefill. Measured 53-72 tok/s decode, ~274 tok/s prefill @4K on M4 Max (oMLX >= 0.6.3, ANE kernel installed separately). Source: github.com/Weschera/Qwen3.8-27B-oMLX-MTP-Mac. Merged into ~/.omlx/settings.json by `lac runtime start`; applies at server startup only.
